notes:
【新增功能】
- 新增「动效制作（Beta）」功能：内置音波、扫光、彩带、声波纹四大实时动效模块，支持一键导出透明或带背景的 WebP、APNG、GIF 与 Lottie (JSON) 动画，首次进入输入邀请码即可解锁。
- 新增 Figma 风格浮动取色面板：支持正方形饱和度/明度色板、色相条、Hex 数值实时联动，并集成 macOS 系统原生全屏放大镜吸管（无需屏幕录制授权即可吸取屏幕任意位置颜色）。
- 音波动效新增「顶部生长」对齐模式，支持顶部、居中、底部三种生长方向切换。

【体验与视觉优化】
- 统一压缩、转换格式、序列帧、智能抠图与动效面板的模块分割线、折叠标题栏、连体分段切换按钮及下拉框样式。
- 优化声波纹画布背景导出开关、彩带填充色板增删交互及纯文字 Toast 垂直居中显示效果。

[New Features]
- Motion Studio (Beta): Built-in Wave, Light Sweep, Confetti Ribbon, and Sound Ripple generators with real-time preview and one-click export to WebP, APNG, GIF, and Lottie (JSON), unlocked via invitation code.
- Figma-Style Color Picker & Native Eyedropper: Square SV color field, hue slider, live Hex input, and native macOS `NSColorSampler` screen magnifier (sample any pixel on screen without screen-recording permissions).
- Wave Alignment: Added Top Growth mode alongside Center and Bottom growth options.

[Improvements & Visual Polish]
- Unified section dividers, collapsible headers, segmented controls, and custom dropdown styling across all workspace panels.
- Improved Ripple background export toggle, Ribbon palette add/remove controls, and vertical centering for text-only toast notifications.
